subject: AWESWELL LIMITED / Sun Rock — historical platform investments, destroyed/written-off work and potential damages evidence
controlling_principle: Historical work that no longer has operating value may still retain evidential and potential compensatory value. No cost or opportunity is recoverable merely because it was incurred; each item requires claimant, legal right, breach/wrong, causation, remoteness, mitigation, quantum and no-double-counting analysis.

evidential_value_rule: Preserve abandoned, expired, superseded and failed transaction documents. Their lack of current commercial value does not negate contemporaneous evidential value concerning intention, readiness, professionalisation, financing, commercial relationships, counterfactual alternatives or loss.
source_boundaries: User declarations are recorded as attributed positions unless independently corroborated.
Signed documents prove their terms and transaction maturity, not automatic completion or recoverability.
Later sale/liquidation can support irreversibility and mitigation analysis but does not by itself prove liability for the original loss.
